 "path": "programs/task-8f2db575.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    # Horizontal bar joins the two markers on its row; vertical rays connect all
    # other markers to that bar at their own columns.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(r for r, c in pts)
    spine = max(counts, key=lambda r: (counts[r] > 1, max(c for rr,c in pts if rr == r)-min(c for rr,c in pts if rr == r)))
    bar = [c for r,c in pts if r == spine]
    left, right = min(bar), max(bar)
    for c in range(left, right + 1):
        if out[spine][c] == 0: out[spine][c] = 3
    for r,c in pts:
        if r == spine: continue
        for rr in range(min(r,spine)+1, max(r,spine)):
            if out[rr][c] == 0: out[rr][c] = 3
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
